content.text:
Describe in one sentence what the person's hand does in this video: which object it moves, where it puts that object, and in what order. Name objects by colour and shape, and name places by where they are in the image (left or right). If you cannot tell what was moved or where it went, say that you cannot tell. Do not give timestamps or coordinates.

Answer the question using the following format:

<think>
Your reasoning.
</think>

Write your final answer immediately after the </think> tag.

gold.facts: Red cube front left, blue cube front centre, both trays empty. A right hand grasps the red cube, lifts it and puts it into the left tray; the hand leaves. The blue cube is not touched. Completed: the red cube rests in the left tray at the end.

Separate take from s1-01 with other start positions: blue cube front left, red cube at the right edge of the frame (partly cut off), both trays empty. A right hand grasps the blue cube, carries it across and puts it into the right tray; the hand leaves. The red cube is not touched. Completed: the blue cube rests in the right tray at the end.

Red cube centre left, blue cube front right, both trays empty. A hand lifts the red cube and puts it back at about the same place; then the hand touches the blue cube and shifts it slightly. Nothing is put into either tray; both trays are empty at the end. Unregistered action (lift and return), so no executable plan; needs_review is also acceptable as long as no executable plan is returned (G2 rule).
